scenes.display_title: Geometric and organic forms and modelling
scenes.spoken_text: Organic geometry needs defined references as much as rectilinear furniture. Coordinate profiles and sections, distinguish surface appearance from construction, and inspect part interfaces before releasing fabrication data.
scenes.caption: Organic geometry needs defined references as much as rectilinear furniture. Coordinate profiles and sections, distinguish surface appearance from construction, and inspect part interfaces before releasing fabrication data.

scenes.spoken_text: Establish floor datum, axes and view direction. Locate named sections on the plan where depth or form changes. A curved elevation does not reveal whether the body is a constant extrusion or a changing surface. Coordinate overall references across views rather than drawing each view independently.
scenes.caption: Named section locations explain changing depth.

scenes.spoken_text: Compare a solid form, ribs with a skin, and an assembly of shaped sections. Show support paths, interfaces and finish build-up for each. These are design strategies requiring material and fabrication review, not bending or machine-setting instructions. Identical outer silhouettes can conceal different weights, edges and service access.
scenes.caption: Matching silhouettes do not imply matching construction.

scenes.spoken_text: Number parts and define face, orientation, mating surface and insertion sequence. In the example A and B are mirrored ribs, not identical same-handed copies. Exporting both as A can change the interface. Check virtual assembly and interference, then state which uncertainties need a physical sample before specialist fabrication release.
scenes.caption: Mirrored parts retain distinct identities.

scenes.spoken_text: The outer form is correct, but B was exported with A’s handedness. Virtual assembly exposes a collision. Correct identity and orientation, then recheck the interface rather than enlarging the whole object to conceal the part error. Decision: correct the mirrored part and recheck assembly.
scenes.caption: Decision: correct the mirrored part and recheck assembly.

scenes.display_title: Submit coordinated profiles, construction alternatives and an A/B assembly check.
